description: Traffic overview from RankControl's own page analytics: total page views, unique visitors, sessions, bounce rate, and average time on page. With scope "site" and Google Analytics connected, the whole site from Google Analytics instead: visits with the same days before, visits from search and from AI by engine, a visits trend, and top pages. When Google Analytics tracks key events, aiConversions says what AI visitors did: key events, the key event rate beside all visits' rate, revenue in the property's currency, and the pages they landed on.

scope.description: "ours" (default): visits to your RankControl articles, from RankControl's own counter. "site": the whole site from Google Analytics, when it is connected.

name: get_traffic_overview
